Plot alpha (within-sample) diversity

Source: R/mp_alpha.R
mp_alpha.Rd

Computes one or more alpha-diversity indices from a phyloseq::phyloseq object and draws publication-ready box, violin or dot plots, optionally annotated with pairwise statistical tests. Rarefaction curves are also supported.

Usage

mp_alpha(
  object,
  measure = c("Shannon", "Observed"),
  group.by = NULL,
  plot.type = c("box", "violin", "dot", "rarefaction"),
  test = c("wilcoxon", "kruskal", "t.test", "anova"),
  add.stats = TRUE,
  comparisons = NULL,
  p.adjust.method = "BH",
  facet.by = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  point.size = 1.5,
  jitter = TRUE,
  theme = NULL,
  ...,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  combine = TRUE,
  interactive = FALSE,
  return.data = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object containing count data.

measure

Character vector of indices. Any of "Observed", "Chao1", "ACE", "Shannon", "Simpson", "InvSimpson", "Fisher", "Pielou" (evenness) and "Faith" (phylogenetic diversity; requires a tree and the picante package).

group.by

Sample-metadata column to compare across (x-axis / fill). If NULL, all samples are pooled into a single group and no test is run.

plot.type

One of "box", "violin", "dot" or "rarefaction".

test

Statistical test for group comparisons: "wilcoxon", "kruskal", "t.test" or "anova". Pairwise post-hoc tests are Dunn (for "kruskal") and Tukey HSD (for "anova").

add.stats

Add significance brackets / p-values when group.by has at least two levels.

comparisons

Optional list of length-2 character vectors specifying which group pairs to test. If NULL, all pairwise comparisons are used.

p.adjust.method

Multiple-testing correction (default "BH").

facet.by

Optional metadata column to facet each panel by.

palette

Palette name, explicit colour vector, or NULL for the default colourblind-safe palette. See mp_palette().

point.size

Size of jittered sample points.

jitter

Overlay individual sample points.

theme

A ggplot2 theme; defaults to the active theme (see mp_set_defaults(), otherwise mp_theme_publication()).

...

Additional arguments passed to the primary geom (boxplot, violin or, for plot.type = "dot", the point summary).

plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption

Optional labels. When NULL, sensible defaults are generated (e.g. the omnibus test result as subtitle).

font.size

Base font size in points.

combine

If multiple measures are requested, combine the panels into a single patchwork object (TRUE) or return a named list of ggplot objects (FALSE).

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires the plotly package). Multiple panels are assembled with plotly::subplot(). Note that some static-only annotations (e.g. significance brackets) are not reproduced by the conversion.

return.data

If TRUE, return the tidy data frame of per-sample diversity estimates and metadata instead of a plot.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

A ggplot object (single measure), a patchwork (multiple measures, combine = TRUE) or a named list of ggplots; a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE; or a data frame when return.data = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(GlobalPatterns, package = "phyloseq")
mp_alpha(GlobalPatterns, measure = c("Shannon", "Observed"),
         group.by = "SampleType")
} # }
